description: Free check for a crypto wallet (btc, eth or sol address): which outbound transfers went to a US-broker-like destination (labelled exchange wallet, deposit address swept to one, or exchange-style consolidation on Bitcoin). Those units are noncovered on Form 1099-DA: the broker reports proceeds with box 9 checked and no cost basis, so the taxpayer must supply basis on Form 8949 (box H or K). Returns units, time and transaction hash per transfer. Read-only public chain data, not tax advice. The paid lot ledger (GET https://api.tensorust.com/v1/wll/lots/{chain}/{address}, $25 over x402) rebuilds the lots and basis behind each transfer.
name: wll_transfer_in_exposure
title: Crypto transfer-in exposure (Form 1099-DA)
